Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Helios AI onboarding milestones & escalation playbook

Hi team and Tim/Alyssa,

Thanks for a productive kickoff this morning. I captured the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (attached) and sketched an initial implementation Gantt. The goal here is to lock owners and realistic milestone dates so we can publish the weekly ops agenda and escalation points.

Key milestones (proposed):
- API keys & network allowlist done — Owner: Jordan — target: 2026-05-18
- Data ingestion & schema validation (sandbox) — Owner: Marissa — target: 2026-05-24
- Integration tests (end-to-end) — Owner: Olga — target: 2026-06-02
- Pilot evaluation & quality check — Owner: Tim (Helios) with Redwood support — target: 2026-06-09
- Go / Production readiness review — Owner: Jordan & Marissa — target: 2026-06-16

Open questions for the group:
1) Can Jordan confirm the account-level firewall window (we proposed 5/18) so engineering can reserve the slot?
2) Marissa — are the dependency items on data mapping (column types + sample extracts) ready by 5/20?
3) Tim/Alyssa — who is the escalation contact on your side for data/production incidents? We need a 24/7 fallback for the pilot.

Attachments: MAP_v1.2.pdf (action items, milestones, RACI), implementation_gantt.xlsx (timeline view).

Next steps: if we can get owner confirmations by EOD Monday (5/11), I'll publish the ops cadence and set up a weekly 30-min sync (Tues/Wed preferred).

Thanks,
Ben
--
